== Introduction ==

This is my deck.  Just asking for suggestions.  I have very limited resourses of cards, so keep that in mind when commenting.

== Strategy ==

Well, obviously the objective goes out first, and that bring out the Epic Event with it, along with Generator Core and the Generator.  I only have one Darth Maul, so I created a Political side to the deck.  The political cards give little advantages here and there towards battle and drains.  I want to basically clear out Theed for myself using Maul and the objective, and drain the crap out of my opponent.  I can also hold political control in the Senate, draining there.  The rest of the "battling" cards are to hold up against my enemy at his locations as best I can while I slowly kill him.

If you can make suggestions, that would be great.  I don't have alot of good cards or money, so if you can suggest common and uncommon cards that might come in handy, or the occasional rare, that would be great.  Thanks.
